  api        Generates a HTML API based on the classes exposed in the extension
  build      Generates/Compiles/Installs a Zephir extension
  clean      Cleans any object files created by the extension

  stubs      Generates stubs that can be used in a PHP IDE

commands.label: Load the generated extension and call the original static method

toolchain_portability: Point generated compiler include flags at the extracted Ubuntu PHP headers.

semantic_scope: The official Zephir generator compiled the unchanged class, and the compiled PHP extension called the original method and printed the greeting.
